idea-plugin.name: Calm Night
idea-plugin.description: Calm Night — a low-eye-strain dark theme for long reading sessions. Off-white text (#c5c8c6) on dark gray (#282c34), desaturated syntax accents, a warm yellow caret, and a chrome that matches the same palette across the IDE, its integrated terminal, Ghostty, and Neovim. Tuned to avoid halation (pure-white bloom) and over-saturated colors that force the eye to refocus.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0 — initial release: UI theme + editor/terminal color scheme.
